subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should the Groq plugin require the first OpenClaw host/API release that supplies `maxTokensSource`, or should it retain the older advertised floor with a separately safe fallback for the discovered default model?
rationale: The implementation needs a compatibility boundary choice: the branch cannot safely claim both an older host floor and a contract field that those hosts do not expose.

options.title: Raise the plugin compatibility floor
options.body: Require the first host and plugin API release that guarantees `maxTokensSource`, then validate install and recovery behavior at that boundary.

options.title: Preserve the older compatibility floor
options.body: Add a conservative older-host recovery path that cannot override configured output budgets, and cover both old-host and current-host behavior.

recommendation.title: Raise the plugin compatibility floor
recommendation.body: Require the first host and plugin API release that guarantees `maxTokensSource`, then validate install and recovery behavior at that boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest targeted fallback repair and are best positioned to validate the concrete compatibility implementation once the release boundary is chosen.
